announcements.title: PhDRacket 0.1.8 Beta is available
announcements.body: Version 0.1.8 Beta shows files from your computer in browser tabs: open an exam PDF, an image or a web page beside your code from the address bar, the Explorer or File > Open File. Version 0.1.7 added Exam Mode. To update, click the Update button in the status bar, or open About and choose Check for updates.
